editorial.blurb: Beatrix is a beloved Chicago breakfast and coffee destination where expertly crafted coffee, thoughtfully prepared dishes, and genuinely welcoming service create an inviting neighborhood gathering spot.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive on Saturday morning—expect a 15-20 minute wait, but order a coffee at the bar while you wait, and ask for a table by the window to soak in the vibrant atmosphere.

topDishes.note: Perfectly cooked egg with fresh jalapeño and arugula, pairs beautifully with extra-crispy hash browns
10/10 standout pastry that shines even when other dishes disappoint
